test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A trader sells 25 kg of rice at ₹1,400. A customer asks for 15% discount. The shopkeeper agrees to it but instead of 1 kg he gives 10% less rice. What is the effective discount that the customer gets (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of 25 kg rice = ₹1400

Customer asks for 15% discount

Shopkeeper gives only 90% of the quantity (10% less per kg)

**Formula used:**

Effective Discount % = [frac{{Value customer should get} - {Value actually received}}{{Value customer should get}}] times 100
